reason: A place where my toddler can play a few feet away while I get an hour of laptop work done with coffee and Wi-Fi is something I'd actually use, so I'd try it as a drop-in. I wouldn't sign up for the $59 membership until I know it works for me.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? $59 a month is a lot if I only go two or three times, and I don't know yet if I can really focus on work with a toddler running around.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper or flexible plan, like a 10-visit pass or a membership that's easy to pause. Seeing it in person and knowing the Wi-Fi and seating suit working would also help.
